q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We'll email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Make sure to check your spam folder if you don't see it!

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes, access on 3 devices, and automatic syncing. You can save 20% by choosing annual billing instead.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month, so for 5 people that would be $40 per month. You can save 20% by choosing annual billing instead.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes on 1 device. If you need more, you can upgrade to Plus (unlimited notes, 3 devices) for $4 per month.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes! Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Since you're within that window, please contact support at support@example.com with your order number and they'll process it for you.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Yes, you can! Plus subscriptions are refundable in full within 14 days of purchase. Since you're just past that window, I'd recommend contacting our support team at support@example.com with your order number—they may be able to help. We typically reply within one business day.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There's no native Linux desktop app for Example Notes, but Linux users can access all features through the web app at no extra cost. Just note that the web app requires an internet connection, unlike the mobile and desktop apps.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Unfortunately, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later, so it won't run on Android 11. You'd need to upgrade your device's OS to use the app. If you have other questions, feel free to ask!

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app requires an active internet connection. However, if you'd prefer to work offline, our mobile (iOS/Android) and desktop (Windows/macOS) apps work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export, and you can export all your notes as PDF. The export will be emailed to you as a ZIP file. Let me know if you need any help!

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Don't worry! Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Just open Trash, select your note, and click "Restore" to get it back.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, Example Notes doesn't support SMS for two-factor authentication. We only support authenticator apps. You can enable it in Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the maximum attachment size is **25 MB per file**. If you need larger attachments, the Plus or Team plans allow up to 250 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep your Plus features until the end of your current billing period. After that, your account reverts to Free. You can cancel anytime in Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted both at rest and in transit. Is there anything else you'd like to know about Example Notes?

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply to support emails within one business day. You can reach us at support@example.com.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes! Annual billing saves you 20% on Plus and Team plans compared to monthly billing.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan ($4/month), you can use Example Notes on up to **3 devices**. The Free plan allows only 1 device, while Plus and Team plans offer more flexibility across multiple devices.
